```{r prep packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
```

```{r prep memory}
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r read data}
file <- "./data/input/C2 RapidResponseActionsLog_asof26-02-12.xlsx" # most recent version

raw.pop <- read_excel(file, sheet = 2, skip = 1)
raw.act <- read_excel(file, sheet = 3, skip = 1)
```

```{r}
pop <- raw.pop %>% 
  filter(group == "plants") %>%
  mutate(genus = str_extract(species, "^[^ ]+"), .after = "species")
```

```{r apparent eradication}
ggplot(pop, aes(x = 1, fill = eradication_status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~ genus, nrow = 2, ncol = 5) +
  labs(title = "status as of XX/XX/XXXX",
       x = NULL,
       y = "# populations") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"))
```
